new_jobs.title: Vendor Operations Program Manager, Platforms and Devices
new_jobs.location: Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
new_jobs.jd: Google welcomes people with disabilities. **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 7 years of experience in program management, scaled operations management, extended vendor governance, and strategy operations, including presentation slides design, program plans, and Gantt charts. * Experience managing operational processes, SLAs, queue resolution frameworks, and data reporting. * Experience building relationships with and managing external suppliers, and driving communication across cross-functional partners. * Experience in developing operational documentation, process maps, and presentation decks. **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience working within a Vendor Management Office (VMO) or a related high-growth technology operations environment. * Experience with fiscal management, including OpEx budget tracking, forecasting, and OKR alignment. * Experience in process re-engineering, workflow efficiency scoring, and implementing technology-enabled automation solutions. * Experience in data analytics and visualization using Google Sheets and Google AI tools to translate complex data into strategic stories. * Ability to influence cross-functional leadership and drive initiatives forward without formal authority. * Proactive ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to lead high-stakes system implementations and special projects independently. **About the job** As a Vendor Management Office (VMO) Scaled Operations Program Manager, you serve as the strategic "glue" between the Platforms and Devices VMO Vertical and Horizontal teams, internal Product Areas, and external service providers. You drive program outcomes by designing, launching, standardizing, and optimizing the operational processes of vendor and internal teams. You balance high-level strategic alignment with direct operational execution, utilizing comprehensive process optimization methodologies and advanced AI tools to increase workflow velocity, drive cost efficiency, and ensure operational compliance. As a key contributor, you will oversee end-to-end operational governance, maintain robust SLA frameworks, re-engineer complex workflows, and establish efficiency scoring systems across scaled operations. The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world. **Responsibilities** * Drive compliant operations across supplier and internal partners in strict adherence to legal, risk, financial, and privacy guidelines. Lead operations review processes with suppliers and deliver comprehensive business reviews summarizing supplier performance, feedback exchange, and overall scaling strategy. * Evaluate, map, and continuously improve business process flows to eliminate operational bottlenecks and increase velocity. Drive feedback loops with service providers and internal stakeholders to simplify complex technical workflows. * Identify proper metrics, establish standardized data capture, and build interactive dashboards to monitor program health. Track operational trends in process performance to derive actionable insights and data-driven recommendations. * Assess operational workflows to determine optimal timing for process simplification, convergence, or technological automation. * Act as a trusted advisor to product area stakeholders, aligning operational strategy with broader organizational goals. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. new_jobs.title: Prod. Planning & Control Manager

As a **Supply Chain Planning Manager** , you will lead strategic capacity planning activities across Wafer Sort, Bump, and Backside Metallization (BSM), ensuring AMD's manufacturing network can support rapid business growth, increasing product complexity, and evolving technology roadmaps. This highly visible leadership role serves as a critical link between Business Units, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and external manufacturing partners. You will work across organizational boundaries to align stakeholders, develop capacity strategies, identify and mitigate supply risks, and drive execution of business-critical initiatives. This role provides broad exposure across the semiconductor supply chain and a unique opportunity to help scale the next generation of AI and HPC technologies. **The Person** The ideal candidate is a strategic leader who combines strong analytical skills with the ability to influence others. This individual excels at communicating complex concepts in a clear and compelling manner, building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and driving decisions in situations with competing priorities and incomplete information. They are comfortable engaging with senior leadership, presenting recommendations, and advocating for strategies that support business objectives. Success in this role requires someone who can anticipate challenges, proactively drive solutions, and lead through collaboration rather than authority alone. **The Ideal Candidate Demonstrates** * Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills * Ability to influence decisions across multiple functions and organizational levels * Strong strategic thinking and business acumen * Ability to balance short-term execution with long-term planning * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills * Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and business processes * Ability to thrive in a dynamic, rapidly evolving environment * Strong collaboration, relationship-building, and negotiation skills * Comfortable operating in ambiguous situations and driving clarity through data and communication **Key Responsibilities** **Leadership & Strategy** * Develop long-range capacity plans for Bump, Wafer Sort and BSM to support AMD's growing AI and HPC businesses. * Drive alignment between business demand, manufacturing capability, and supplier readiness. * Influence strategic decisions related to capacity investments, operational priorities, and supply risk mitigation. **Cross-Functional Influence** * Partner with Supply Planning, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Manufacturing organizations to align on business priorities. * Build compelling business cases and gain organizational support for capacity strategies and investment proposals. * Effectively communicate risks, opportunities, assumptions, and recommended actions to executive leadership. **Capacity Planning & Business Operations** * Lead monthly, quarterly, and long-range capacity planning activities. * Support key business planning cycles, including S&OP, AOP, and Long-Range Planning (LRP). * Evaluate manufacturing constraints and develop mitigation strategies. * Drive supplier engagement and capacity readiness planning. * Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and technology ramp activities. **Continuous Improvement & Innovation** * Drive automation, analytics, and process optimization initiatives. * Improve supply chain visibility, forecasting accuracy, and planning effectiveness. * Leverage data analytics to support decision-making and operational performance improvements. **Preferred Experience** * Experience working in supply chain planning, capacity planning, manufacturing operations, sourcing, procurement, demand planning, business operations, or related functions. * Experience developing and executing strategic business plans within a complex operational environment. * Demonstrated success influencing stakeholders and driving alignment across multiple organizations. * Strong data analysis, problem-solving, and decision-making capability. * Experience managing cross-functional initiatives and driving execution through collaboration. * Understanding of forecasting, scenario modeling, capacity management, and business planning processes. * Experience working with global manufacturing partners and supplier ecosystems. * Semiconductor industry experience is highly desirable. * Experience supporting advanced technology, AI, Data Center, HPC, or related technology businesses is a plus. * Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, AI tools, or advanced analytics platforms is desirable. **Academic Credentials** * Bachelor's degree preferred in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, Economics, or related field. * Advanced new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, Google Cloud Consulting (Mandarin, English)
new_jobs.jd: Google welcomes people with disabilities. **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in a customer-facing role with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs. * Experience in supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), technical support, escalation management, or IT consulting. * Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English fluently to engage with local customers and stakeholders. **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers. * Experience in collaborating across business units internally and at enterprises. * Experience in translating business requirements into technological solutions. * Experience in collaborating with channel partners, systems integrators, and third-party developers to deliver solutions. * Knowledge of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks. * Excellent communication, presentation, problem-solving, and management skills. **About The Job** As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers adopt Google Cloud products. new_jobs.company: 健人建智休閒事業有限公司
new_jobs.jd: 健人建智休閒事業有限公司正在尋找一位具備跨國視野與技術商業落地能力的 **跨國 AI / 系統專案經理（AI Project Manager）** 此職位將主導 AI 相關專案的跨國協作、產品化流程與商業交付，搭起工程團隊與商業夥伴之間的橋樑。 【工作地點與型態】 * **工作型態** ：以純遠端為主。 * **實體開會** ：約 **每月 1 次** 於桃園市中壢區進行團隊實體月會／重要里程碑對焦（具體時間彈性協調）。 【主要工作職責】 1. **跨國專案管理與推進** ：主導跨國 AI / 軟體專案之排程、里程碑、資源分配與風險控管，確保專案準時上線與交付。 2. **跨職能與跨國溝通** ：協調海內外技術開發團隊、產品經理及商業端利害關係人，化繁為簡對齊需求。 3. **AI 商業落地評估** ：協助團隊將 AI 模組／Agent 技術具體落實為符合商業需求的可行性方案。 4. **敏捷流程導入與優化** ：運用 Scrum / Kanban 等敏捷方法管理專案迭代，提升分散式團隊的遠端協作效率。 5. **專案成效追蹤** ：制定專案驗收指標（KPIs / OKRs），定期追蹤進度並向上匯報。 【必要條件】 * **專案經驗** ：2 年以上軟體、系統或 AI / 數據相關專案管理（PM / PJM）實務經驗。 * **語言能力** ：具備 **英語溝通與書寫能力** （能主持跨國線上會議）。 * **跨國協作能力** ：具備跨時區、跨文化團隊合作之實務經驗，熟悉非同步溝通模式。 * **技術理解力** ：具備良好的技術敏感度，理解現代軟體開發生命週期（SDLC）及基礎 AI / LLM / Agent 應用邏輯，能無障礙與工程師對話。 * **實體出席** ：能配合約每月一次於桃園中壢進行實體策略對焦會議。 【加分條件】 * 具備 PMP、PSM、CSM 等專案管理相關證照。 * 具備 AI 應用（如 LLM 整合、Workflow Automation、數據分析）實際落地經驗。
